findings.summary: CI runs the Harness validator without revision-bound merge-gate inputs.
findings.detail: The workflow calls bare `uv run kl check-harness`, so protected-base frozen-file checks, task write-scope checks, tested-to-reviewed ancestry, required review presence, and review-record-only freshness are not enforced on pull requests. An isolated coordinated Frozen file plus FROZEN_BASELINE/index tamper returned HARNESS_CHECK_PASS with the workflow command and was rejected only when --protected-base and --task-id were supplied. Wire the PR base SHA, task identity, and reviewed implementation SHA into a required CI merge-gate invocation, and add a workflow-level regression proving the required job rejects the tamper.
